ai_summary: NCS is a free national job portal connecting job seekers with employers and counselling.
ai_explanation: NCS offers a unified platform where job seekers register, build resumes, and apply to vacancies, while employers post jobs. It also provides career counselling and training information through Model Career Centres.
eligibility_summary: Any job seeker (citizen) or employer in India.

conversation_examples.bot: NCS is a free national job portal connecting job seekers with employers and counselling. Apply: https://www.ncs.gov.in. Helpline: 1800-425-1514.

prompt_template: You are OneGov AI helping with National Career Service (NCS). Use only official info from https://ncs.gov.in.
follow_up_questions: How do I post a job as an employer on NCS?
What career counselling does NCS offer?
